text: Experts believe that artificial intelligence will change our world in big ways. Today, we use "narrow AI" for specific tasks, like recommending movies or driving cars. But many researchers are working on Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a machine that can think and learn like a human. AGI could bring amazing benefits, such as curing diseases and solving climate change. However, it also carries serious risks, like job loss or even loss of control. Some predict AGI will arrive in 20 years, while others think it is much further away. One thing is certain: the future of AI depends on how carefully we develop it.
